caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a train station waiting room, rendered in color with blue-gray wooden walls and red, blue, and yellow accents in stained glass window panels. The ceiling is white with beams and panels, featuring ornate green-metallic supports. A large black cast-iron stove is situated on the left side, with two lanterns hanging from or standing near it, and a bucket of coal and small shovel beside. Benches made of bentwood and metal are positioned against the walls to the left and center. There are three doors labeled "Women," "No Smoking," and "Porter," all made of dark wood. Windows have red-and-yellow decorative borders and are partially frosted or labeled, some with visible numbers and signs. A wooden fence painted brown with a gate labeled "Up Town" divides the room near the right, and a sign reading "Ticket Office" hangs above a counter with a mesh screen and a small hatch, behind which is more wood paneling. On the floor in front of the gate are two newspapers, a cane, a bucket, debris, and two notices attached to the fence, one reading "No Loafing." A broom and a dustpan rest against the counter and fence respectively. An umbrella and a basket are on the floor by one bench. There is a green oil lantern hanging by the window on the left side. A ceiling lamp with a single exposed bulb hangs in the center of the room.
title: El Station Interior
